content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Designs and imports cutting tools, measuring tools and first aid kits, a consumer and safety products business, not drug manufacturing."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures generic prescription drugs including injectables, sold to wholesalers, pharmacies and hospitals, closely matching Amphastar's model."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Makes specialty chemical ingredients and additives for industrial formulators, not pharmaceutical products sold to hospitals and pharmacies."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells orthopedic medical devices and biologics for pain and bone healing to surgeons, a different product category."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Branded household, personal care and vitamin consumer products sold through mass retailers, not generic drugs."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Cannabis cultivation and dispensary retail, a different regulated product and customer base."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Cannabis cultivation and dispensary retail, unrelated to generic injectable or inhalation drugs."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Manufactures generic oral drugs sold to pharmaceutical marketing partners under FDA approval, though dosage forms differ from Amphastar's."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Main business is IV infusion pumps and disposable infusion sets; injectable drugs are secondary to devices."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sells branded opioid-use-disorder treatments rather than generic injectables and inhalers across broad therapeutic lines."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Mainly earns royalties on respiratory drugs made by partners, with a small hospital antibiotics line, not generic manufacturing."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes neurosurgical instruments, implants and tissue matrices, medical devices rather than drugs."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Develops branded radiopharmaceutical imaging agents and generators, a specialty diagnostic business unlike generic injectables."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures disposable interventional medical devices such as catheters and guidewires, not pharmaceuticals."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Produces tissue-based wound care skin substitutes, a biologic and device product line unlike generic drugs."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Sells branded non-opioid surgical pain injections and a nerve-pain device, not generic injectable drugs."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Designs pneumatic compression therapy devices for lymphedema used at home, a medical device business."},{"label":"C18","good":false,"reason":"Broad portfolio of vascular access, surgical and anesthesia medical devices, not drugs."},{"label":"C19","good":false,"reason":"Makes spine implants and bone graft products sold to spine surgeons, a device and orthobiologic business."}]}
